source_standard: NIST SP 800-161r1 (C-SCRM), https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/upd1/final — NIST IR 8286 lineage cited by secondary sources only, not independently fetched this pass (scout-brief gap, stated as assumption)

reference_resolution.rule: owner must resolve to an actual assigned person or role; risk_id must resolve to an actual registered risk-register entry — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: every registered risk_id must carry a treatment/owner pair before reaching a terminal loop_state — NIST-lineage completeness, checked at write time, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a new risk is identified on the branch AND no risk-management record exists yet for that risk_id
